text:
Warracker 
 
 Open-source warranty tracker for individuals and teams. 
The easiest way to organize product warranties, monitor expiration dates, and store receipts or related documents.
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 

⭐ If you find Warracker helpful, we’d truly appreciate a star on GitHub! Your support motivates us to keep improving and building great new features.

 

 🌟Overview

 Warracker is a web-based application that simplifies the management of product warranties. It allows users to organize warranty information, monitor expiration dates, and securely store related documents.

Full guides live in the Warracker Wiki: setup, the complete user guide, configuration, backup and restore, updating, reverse proxies, security, troubleshooting, and contributing.

 🔑 Key Features

 Feature Description 
 -------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 🗃️ Centralized Management Track all your product warranties in one place 
 🧾 Detailed Records Store purchase dates, durations, notes, multiple serial numbers, and product photos with thumbnail previews 
 📄 Document Storage Upload receipts, invoices, and manuals securely 
 📝 Warranty Claims Manage warranty claims end-to-end with statuses, dates, resolutions, attached documents, and full lifecycle visibility 
 🔔 Proactive Alerts Get alerts for upcoming expirations via email or 100+ push services (Discord, Slack, etc.) using Apprise — each threshold notifies once, never daily repeats 
 🔍 Quick Search and Filter Search by product name, serial number, vendor, and more with real-time filtering, and organize with custom tags 
 👥 Multi-User & Global View Multiple accounts with admin controls; authenticated users can view global warranty data with role-based permissions 
 📤 Data Export/Import Import/export warranty data via CSV — exports include every field (notes, currency, model, warranty type), so a re-import restores your data exactly 
 ⚙️ Customizable Settings Configure currency, date formats, notification timing, and branding 
 📦 Archiving Archive expired or unused warranties for better organization, while keeping records accessible when needed 
 🔑 OIDC SSO Single sign-on with providers like Google, GitHub, and Keycloak 
 📊 Status Dashboard Visual analytics and stats with charts, tables, and global/user views — including Total Value (in your default currency) and Archived summary cards, plus CSV export of the filtered view 
 📦 Paperless-ngx Integration Store/manage documents directly in Paperless-ngx with file-level control 
 📖 Localization Support Full multilingual UI with 20 languages, RTL support, instant language switching, and native name display 

---

 Project Status

 Warracker is in active development. 
The essential features are reliable and ready for everyday use. Development is ongoing, with regular updates and improvements.

 ✅ Stable core for tracking, notification , and managing warranty documents, files
 ✅ Full support for self-hosted deployments
 ⚒️ Advanced enhancements are still being worked on
 ✍️ Your feedback and bug reports help shape the future of the app

More screenshots, including the table view, the card menu, and dark mode, are in the User Guide.

 🛠️Technology Stack

 Frontend : HTML, CSS, JavaScript
 Backend : Python with Flask
 Database : PostgreSQL
 Containerization : Docker and Docker Compose
 Web Server : Nginx

 🗺️Roadmap

The current release is 1.0.6 . What's planned next, 1.0.7 and the feature requests under consideration, lives on the Roadmap page in the wiki. Shipped work is in the changelog and the releases.

 Prerequisites

 Docker and Docker Compose installed on your system.

3. Open in your browser. The first account you create automatically becomes the admin.

The Getting Started guide walks through each install route step by step, and Configuration documents every .env variable.

 Other platforms

 
 
 

One-click installs on Unraid (Community Apps), Proxmox VE (community helper script), and TrueNAS SCALE (Apps catalog) — see the proxmox/ and truenas/ guides.

 
 Full docker-compose.yml reference 

 

 

 📝 Usage

The User Guide walks through every screen, button, and field; the essentials are below.

 Accounts & Roles

- The first account created in the system will automatically become the Admin account . 
- The Admin can manage other users, assign roles, and has full system permissions. 
- Regular users can only manage their own warranties unless granted additional privileges by the Admin. 

 Adding a Warranty

1. Fill in the product details by clicking on Add Warranty . 
2. Enter the purchase date and warranty duration. 
3. Optionally upload receipt/documentation. 
4. Click the Add Warranty button. 

 Managing Warranties

- Use the search box to filter warranties. 
- Click the edit icon to modify warranty details. 
- Click the delete icon to remove a warranty. 
- A warranty that expires today is still counted as active (not expired) across the dashboard, warranty lists, and expiry notifications. 

To import, click Data Import and choose a CSV file. The full field reference — formats, which fields are required, and how exports encode values — is in the User Guide.

---

 🌐 Localization Support

Warracker offers full multilingual UI support with 20 languages , including RTL (Right-to-Left) support , instant language switching, and native name display. The language is auto-detected from your browser on first visit and saved to your profile. The full list of supported languages is in the User Guide.

install.title: Setup
install.html:
Prerequisites
  • Docker and Docker Compose installed on your system.
Steps
mkdir warracker && cd warracker
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sassanix/Warracker/main/Docker/docker-compose.yml
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sassanix/Warracker/main/Docker/.env.example
mv .env.example .env
  1. Fill in the required values in your .env file (database credentials, SECRET_KEY, etc.).
  2. Start the stack:
    docker compose up -d
  3. Open http://localhost:8005 in your browser. The first account you create automatically becomes the admin.

The Getting Started guide walks through each install route step by step, and Configuration documents every .env variable.

Other platforms

One-click installs on Unraid (Community Apps), Proxmox VE (community helper script), and TrueNAS SCALE (Apps catalog) — see the proxmox/ and truenas/ guides.

Full docker-compose.yml reference
services:
  warracker:
    image: ghcr.io/sassanix/warracker/main:latest
    ports:
      - "8005:80"
    volumes:
      - warracker_uploads:/data/uploads
    env_file:
      - .env
    depends_on:
      warrackerdb:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  warrackerdb:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    env_file:
      - .env
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $$POSTGRES_USER -d $$POSTGRES_DB"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  warracker_uploads:
